title: Open E1 Reviewer on the iPad and sign in
summary: Open your E1's /reviewer/ address in Safari on the iPad, sign in with your company account, and add it to the Home Screen; the E1 Reviewer app, once released, signs in the same way.

title: Your profile and organization
summary: The avatar in the top bar shows who is signed in, the organizations you belong to, and Sign out; tap another organization to work in it.

training.topic: Profile and organizations on the iPad

title: The dashboard
summary: Home and each project's Overview show a dashboard of cards; in a project, every 2D space (with pins), the documents, pinned 2D spaces, redlines and recent changes.

title: Customize a dashboard for you, the project or the organization
summary: Customize adds, removes, orders and sizes the cards and saves the dashboard for you, for everyone in the project, or for everyone in the organization.
roles: Everyone for Just me; a project administrator for Everyone in the project; an organization administrator for Everyone in the organization

title: Projects as tiles you arrange
summary: Home shows your projects as tiles; touch and hold a tile, or tap Arrange, and drag the tiles into the order you want. The order is kept for you.

title: A project's sheets
summary: A project lists its sheets on the left, and the list can be hidden; the sheet shows as E1 draws it. One finger moves it, two fingers zoom; pin the sheets you use most.
roles: Everyone with a role in the project

title: An object or a connection: properties, attributes, history and chat
summary: Tap a symbol, a pipe, a signal or a cable on a sheet to see its object: properties, every attribute, its history and its chat.
roles: Everyone with a role in the project; writing in the chat needs a role that may comment

title: Photos and voice notes
summary: Take a photo with the iPad's camera or record a voice note and add it to an object, a comment or a task; they are kept with the object's files in E1.
roles: Everyone with a role in the project that may edit the object (adding files)

title: Redline a sheet
summary: Redline draws on a sheet with a pen, a cloud, an arrow or text in four colors; each mark says what it means and carries a note, and its status can be set.
roles: Everyone with a role in the project that may comment; setting another person's status needs a role that may resolve comments

title: For me: your tasks and checklists
summary: For me lists the tasks and checklists assigned to you in every project; tick the items, add items, comment with photos and voice notes, and mark a task done.
roles: Everyone; ticking needs the task to be yours or a role that may edit it

training.topic: Tasks and checklists on the iPad

title: Search
summary: The search field finds projects, sheets, objects and connections by tag or name, and tasks; an object opens as its own page, with its sheets one tap away.

title: Alex on the iPad
summary: Alex on the iPad is Ask: questions typed or spoken with the microphone, answered without changing anything.
roles: Everyone with a role in the project
